name: Rockhounds
description:
About This Game

EXTRACT OR DIE TRYING

Gear up, drop in, and fight for your life in a galaxy where only the richest can survive. You and your squad are the disposable workforce of the Megacorps, sent to hostile planets to extract precious minerals.

Team up in 1-4 player co-op to mine, hunt, build and battle your way through deadly contracts. Every mission is a gamble: the higher the risk, the bigger the payout… but make the wrong move and it could cost you everything.

A GALAXY OF CHAOS

No two contracts are ever the same. You will face deadly anomalies, brutal weather conditions and waves of feral creatures and rival corporate security forces.

Rockhounds features unique planets, each packed with distinct biomes and challenges. Every drop is a test of teamwork, skill and strategy.

STRATEGIZE, FIGHT & GET RICH

Switch between mining, building and combat as you tackle increasingly high-risk contracts. Craft and upgrade your equipment to build your ultimate merc. Specialize in mining, combat, engineering or support. Rally your squad, strategize for the best approach, and get ready to mine, fight, and escape with your life (and your paycheck) intact.
short_desc: Rockhounds is a 1-4 player extraction shooter where you and your squad brave the deadliest planets to extract minerals for ruthless Megacorps. Every mission is a fight for survival, wealth, and glory. Will you conquer the chaos and escape with your team? Gear up, and prove you’ve got what it takes!
